intent: 画面中央的圆形光斑像心跳一样有节奏地放大缩小、亮度脉动

iterations.critique: The pulse is unmistakable — antiphase sampling shows a big bright blob at t1.25 vs a smaller dimmer one at t1.75, smooth radial falloff, warm light read. One artifact breaks 'dark surroundings': at sub-100% scale the solid's boundary shows as a faint grey rectangle frame (the ramp end color [0.01,0.01,0.02] is lighter than the pure-black comp behind it).

Both fixes landed: pure-black ramp end + scale-up-only pulse removed the layer-boundary rectangle entirely (corners are true black), and the antiphase frames show a clear heartbeat — larger brighter core at t1.25 vs smaller dimmer warmer-rimmed blob at t1.75. Soft radial falloff, single centered light. All criteria met.
